title: Connect the log radar as a source of incidents
description:
**Milestone:** Later, coarse

**Goal.** The radar's hot, new blips become events of kind `radar.blip` in the same format, so the radar feeds the same routing. After CloudWatch and app events, per direction. See initiative kanbus-6f9fc4.

**Acceptance.**
Spec'd when started.

**Depends on:** kanbus-64fc60
